notes.title: update 15/01/2015
notes.content:
- We added a configurator to manage your keybinding and resolution.
You will need Java to use it.

- Several art fixes

notes.title: update notes 03-01-2015
notes.content:
- The guards are more responsive and are more vicious in tracking you down.

- Small fixes in the environment where it could cause some problems for some players.

- The player now has a first person mode ;)

- The camera controls are also improved.

- There is now a tutorial in place of the notes.

- We also improved the performance of most of the levels, you should have more fps now.

notes.title: Launch Announcements
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

we have decided to keep the most of the translations behind because of our time restraint going for our release.
All the translations and the linux and mac os x support will be added soon. 


Translations added will be:
- Dutch
- Russian
- German
- French
- Portuguese
- Polish
- Turkish


We want to thank you all for your patience and enjoy!
